quiz.question_id: Fungsi mana yang akan dikenali `go test` sebagai benchmark?
quiz.question_en: Which function will `go test` recognize as a benchmark?
options_en: `func BenchmarkReverse(b *testing.B)`
`func TestBenchmarkReverse(t *testing.T)`
`func BenchReverse()`
`func BenchmarkReverse(n int)`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa body benchmark harus diulang dengan `for i := 0; i < b.N; i++`?
quiz.question_en: Why must the benchmark body be repeated with `for i := 0; i < b.N; i++`?
options_id: Karena Go menyesuaikan `b.N` otomatis untuk mendapat pengukuran yang lebih stabil
Karena loop biasa tidak diizinkan dalam benchmark
Karena `b.N` selalu sama dengan jumlah CPU
options_en: Because `b.N` is the number of workers
Because Go automatically adjusts `b.N` to get a more stable measurement
Because ordinary loops are not allowed in benchmarks
Because `b.N` is always equal to the CPU count

quiz.question_id: Output tambahan apa yang ditampilkan oleh flag `-benchmem`?
quiz.question_en: What extra output is shown by the `-benchmem` flag?
options_id: Bytes per operation dan allocations per operation
options_en: The number of packages tested
Coverage statements
Bytes per operation and allocations per operation
Only the start and end timestamps

quiz.question_id: Pada output `BenchmarkReverse-8`, angka `8` menandakan apa menurut legend lesson?
quiz.question_en: In the output `BenchmarkReverse-8`, what does the `8` mean according to the lesson's legend?
options_en: The number of sub-benchmarks
The default value of `b.N`
The GOMAXPROCS value when the benchmark ran
The Go major version

quiz.question_id: Dua implementasi menghasilkan `200 ns/op` dan `350 ns/op`. Mana yang lebih cepat per operasi?
quiz.question_en: Two implementations produce `200 ns/op` and `350 ns/op`. Which one is faster per operation?
options_id: Yang `350 ns/op` karena angkanya lebih besar
Yang `200 ns/op` karena butuh waktu lebih sedikit per operasi
options_en: The `350 ns/op` one because the number is larger
The `200 ns/op` one because it takes less time per operation
They are the same; `ns/op` is only decorative
They cannot be compared without `-v`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa `strings.Builder` cenderung mengalahkan `s += "x"` di loop konkatenasi?
quiz.question_en: Why does `strings.Builder` tend to beat `s += "x"` in a concatenation loop?
options_id: Karena `Builder` mereuse buffer alih-alih membuat string baru setiap iterasi
options_en: Because `Builder` reuses a buffer instead of creating a new string on every iteration
Because `Builder` always performs zero allocations
Because the `+` operator is forbidden in benchmarks
Because `Builder` runs in parallel

options_id: Setelah setup mahal selesai dan tepat sebelum bagian yang ingin diukur
options_en: After expensive setup finishes and just before the part you want to measure
After the benchmark loop ends
Every time `b.N` changes
Only if the benchmark fails

options_id: Menghentikan pengukuran sementara saat menjalankan pekerjaan yang tidak ingin dihitung
options_en: To end the benchmark entirely
To pause all worker goroutines
To temporarily stop measurement while running work you do not want counted
To reset `b.N` to zero

quiz.question_id: Apa arti `1 allocs/op` pada output benchmark?
quiz.question_en: What does `1 allocs/op` mean in benchmark output?
options_id: Total hanya ada 1 alokasi selama seluruh proses benchmark
Rata-rata ada 1 alokasi heap untuk setiap operasi yang diukur
options_en: There was only 1 total allocation during the whole benchmark
There is an average of 1 heap allocation for each measured operation
Only one goroutine was allocated
The benchmark ran only once

quiz.question_en: What is the practical effect of `go test -bench=. -benchtime=5s`?
options_id: Setiap operasi harus selesai dalam 5 detik
Benchmark dijalankan lebih lama agar hasil lebih akurat
Go mematikan garbage collector selama 5 detik
options_en: Every operation must finish within 5 seconds
The benchmark runs longer so the results are more accurate
Go disables the garbage collector for 5 seconds
All benchmarks are repeated exactly 5 times
